name: Lezette
source:
“Everything I am exists for the princess. If I can protect her, I need nothing else.”

Originally a commoner, he was recognized for his exceptional sword skills and became the heroine’s personal knight.

He swears absolute loyalty to her, placing his mistress above all else in every matter.

In truth, he harbors a secret love for her, but remains steadfast in maintaining his role as her devoted knight.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/sr/sien/]the official website[/url].]
